Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2212.10077v3. Synthetic contrastive controller training and long-range/factual-consistency limits establish data-generation/evaluation scope. Passage ratings are not whole-novel reliability or family qualification. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DOC is specialized for English stories, expensive human evaluation limits detailed ablations, and factual consistency was not a focus; inconsistent names or genders can arise during outlining and cascade into drafting.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DOC combines hierarchical detailed outlines with an OPT-350 m FUDGE-style controller trained contrastively on passage summaries; hard negatives splice off-topic continuations into initially relevant passages to maintain outline relevance.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Controller training summarized WritingPrompts passages using InstructGPT3-13B; evaluation used 1, 000–1, 500-word corresponding passages from 20 stories, with three Surge AI annotators comparing each pair on coherence, relevance and interestingness.
